profile.name: Brendan Eggers
profile.headline: Forward Deployed and Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Forward Deployed and Senior Software Engineer who takes ambiguous products and requirements and finds the answers and valuable path forward. Nine years of full-stack product work, from NBA.com to solo ventures. I thrive in opportunities that require meshing together domain knowledge across the organization.

experience.note: Forward deployed engineer guiding the organization to the AI-Native frontier

bullets.text: Administered Claude Teams subscription for 50+ users, establishing robust access policies and usage guardrails to ensure secure AI adoption.
Established and led the AI Builders Committee, training 20+ non-technical staff in prompt engineering, context-window management, and agent-building workflows.
Partnered with 3 Asset Management leaders to build an MCP server, reducing property lookup time from hours to a single agent question.
Shipped Upcredit, a rent-reporting credit product now live across the company's student-housing portfolio and built to run with almost no upkeep, generating pure profit each month.
Developed a vertically integrated student housing rental tool that tracks 3,000 assets across 300 markets, improving data accessibility.

experience.note: Independent venture founded in 2023 and incubated at LV Collective since October 2024.

bullets.text: Spearheaded the end-to-end development of a SaaS product, including ETL, React frontend, and React Native mobile app, processing 3M+ receipt rows.
Architected the full stack from authentication and security to subscription checkout and code quality as the solo engineer, later coordinating 3 contractors through project delivery.
Ran LLM modules in production for classification and fuzzy address matching, gating each with deterministic checks and adding a second-pass reviewer that flagged disagreements for human review.
Drove product improvements through direct customer conversations; grew to over 500 users.
Designed an agent harness with custom lint rules and immutable PreToolUse guardrail hooks to enforce code standards across generated code.

experience.note: Served as lead engineer for client-side authentication, subscription checkout, and third-party account linking across NBA digital properties.

bullets.text: Operated NBA.com's score strip, serving 1+ million users daily during peak game traffic.
Tech-led the League Pass purchase page and block-rendering system, making architecture and delivery decisions across 5 engineers on different teams; front door to 100K+ annual subscriptions.

Built the subscription offering and entitlements association for Local Access in-market streaming across NBA and WNBA team markets, ensuring tens of thousands of new subscribers could watch content through the app's streaming platform.
Led the Authentication and Account Linking flows connecting thousands of users with Nike, YouTube, FanDuel, and other distribution partners.
Rotated to the DevOps team and created an internal self-service repository-generation tool used by 5+ DTC teams while running Kubernetes at scale.

Core engineer on the conversion of the company's e-commerce platform to React, shipping dozens of data-rich React/Redux apps. A performance investigation connected a blocked render path directly to subscription conversion.
